initial_turn.subject: Request for Quote – Alternate Shipping Address
initial_turn.body:
Hello,

I am reaching out from WonderToys Co. to request a quote for several items for our upcoming promotional event. We would like to include the following products:

- 10 units of the MagicToyland Adventure Doll
- 15 units of the SmartToys Building Blocks
- 20 T-Shirts (please use the standard T-Shirt we have ordered previously)

For this order, we need the shipment to go to our alternate warehouse location, not our main office. Please ship to our "Eastside Distribution Center" as you have on previous orders. I believe this address is already saved in your system, but just to clarify, it's the one we use for bulk shipments. If you need any additional details, let me know.

Please confirm that the quote will reflect this alternate shipping address and not our default billing location. If you require any further information or need to verify which address I am referring to, please reach out.

Best regards,
WonderToys Co.
